findings.observation: Stages 10 and 11 no longer expose stage 9 add controls or delete controls; final preview is two rows and toggles, not the accumulated task manager.
The stage 9 add button accepts a real click inside an inert snapshot but does not add; this stage has no external live input/action controls.
Quick example for map() shows filter() from its related lesson instead of the term’s own map example.
Long source grows the line-number gutter beyond the editor or leaves numbers unsynchronized when scrolling.
Fresh top navigation opens advanced mode; lesson entry opens simple mode. Preserve saved preference but choose simple when none exists.
